purpose: Standalone build, packaging, CLI, and compatibility adaptations required around the pinned LibreCAD source snapshot.
disallowed: Unreviewed changes inside imported src/ files

entries.reason: Install the three narrow transitive headers required by the imported public façades; hide HandleAllocator and the DataStorage operation enum in a follow-up.
Restore the historical dint*/duint*/ddouble* public typedef names removed by the target C++17 conversion and expose the shared operation-diagnostic schema.
Default the newly added addDimArc callback so existing concrete consumers remain instantiable.
Provide a deprecated composition-based dwgR read façade instead of an unsafe alias to dwgRW, and expose the diagnostic snapshot on both façade spellings.
Define the out-of-line dwgR forwarding façade, preserve null DWG argument/error compatibility, and instrument stage-aware operation diagnostics.

Remove two unused target locals exposed by standalone -Werror compilation and route the fixed-type GEOPOSITIONMARKER entity through the mapped reader instead of treating its legacy class ordinal as an opaque object.
Remove an unused readSchemaNames parameter exposed by standalone -Werror compilation; parsing behavior is unchanged.

Mark one intentionally unused helper, remove two unused locals exposed by standalone -Werror compilation, and reject non-finite GEOPOSITIONMARKER and LIGHT entity-body values plus bounded LIGHT strings/color before encoding.
Expose the fixed GEOPOSITIONMARKER DWG type code to the shared reader dispatch while keeping the target's existing utility enums intact.
Compact high custom class ordinals into file-local legacy slots for AC1015/AC1018 so the R2004 CLASSES range remains compatible with independent readers; modern ordinals are unchanged.

Keep AC1015 entity-chain validation strict for built-in entities while allowing the target's RTEXT/ARCALIGNEDTEXT/HELIX/CAMERA custom frames to use preserved high handles; their object-map and class-instance ledgers remain validated separately.
Retain the imported warning-hygiene fixes and correct GEODATA AC1015/AC1018 inline versus R2007+ deferred host-block handle ordering per ODA §20.4.78, with bounded version-2 parity evidence.
entries.scope: warning hygiene and DWG object compatibility

entries.reason: Expose the explicit standalone-safe versus LibreCAD-master legacy classifier profile to the internal DXF reader probe without changing the public façade.

Use the canonical DXF group-code table, preserve integer values in codes 260-269, fail closed on the unassigned 482-998 span, and carry an explicit opt-in legacy classifier profile for compatibility probes.

Route raw DXF capture and replay through canonical or explicitly selected classifier profiles, preserve null/error compatibility, instrument stage-aware operation diagnostics, and ignore inactive HATCH gradient carriers while retaining active-gradient validation.
Expose the structured operation-diagnostic snapshot while preserving the legacy dxfRW error and version API, and retain an internal classifier-profile switch for raw replay probes.
Make the documented setCustomDebugPrinter(nullptr) reset restore an owned default printer so later debug-level transitions cannot dereference null.
